source: Use the existing official gas, UCI late, year-long instrument and SGP40 B/C splits. B/C are now development cases for this second decision. Do not promote a new default from these replays alone.
model: Train a balanced multinomial or binary logistic regression on source rows, with scaler fitted on source only. Each subsequent eligible batch fit the same logistic recipe from source rows plus already revealed target rows. Source total weight equals its row count; target receives equal aggregate weight to source, each present class equal within a domain. C=1, seed 17, maximum 1000 iterations. Zero target rows means the source classifier. Source-only available features, median imputation; no label-informed feature selection.
decision: Observer calibration is default. Train the candidate at every eligible batch; choose it only if its historical issued predictions on previous returned samples have cumulative macro-F1 at least 0.01 above observer. At least two returned batches required; tie retains observer. Equal feedback to all arms.
controls: static strong sources from the same measurement
budget: Seed 17 for deterministic feedback picks, inherited number per source (32 public and UCI late, 4 year-long, 8 SGP40). At most one new fit between batches in any arm. Record CPU time, training count, chosen batches and paired changed outcomes; fixed controls have zero target retraining.
gate: To justify independent verification, adaptive decision must beat both always-refit and observer by at least 0.01 in at least two physical instrument or drift streams, with no absolute loss over 0.01 to observer on official public and no worst-class recall loss exceeding 0.02 to observer in claimed wins. Track best observed fixed expert as a further competitor. Stop this default proposal if gate fails.
